body:
Restacked: this PR now targets `feature/niw2-585-send-to-master` (#457) instead of `feature/niw2-578-prepare-screen`. The stack is #448 ← #458 ← #455 ← #457 ← #456.

Merge commit 8f3eea4a brings #457 (and, through it, #455 and #458) in — merge, no rebase or force push. Conflicts and how they were resolved, keeping both sides:

- `status-card.tsx` / `status-card.module.css`: #455's `plainIcon` and this PR's `bareIcon` were the same option (the icon brings its own tile). One prop remains, `bareIcon`, and the post-recording card now uses it. `StatusCardButton` keeps this PR's `text` variant, `grow`, `onDragStart` and `label`, plus #455's `title` tooltip.
- `export-runner.ts`: the job keeps both this PR's `destination` (names the copy on the cards) and #457's `wholeRecording` (feeds "Copies from this master").
- `backlog/prepare-screen.md`: the Decisions list keeps #458's entries and this PR's "progress and ready cards" line; the flow and "How to validate" now use the named cards ("Preparing your YouTube copy…", "Your YouTube copy is ready"). `background-copy-toasts.md`'s banner names the new base.

Also in this merge: the 32 `prepare.*` i18n keys nothing references any more (the old one-column page, the quick chips, "Prepare for…"), which #458 and #457 left on purpose to keep sibling branches mergeable, are pruned from `en.json` and `es.json`. Each was checked for zero references across `apps/` and `packages/`, including dynamic key building.

`bun run verify` is green on the merged branch.
